# Christa Eloranta — public professional profile

Canonical website: https://christaeloranta.fi/
Source: public website content in https://github.com/ch-risto/christaeloranta.fi
Language: Finnish

## Professional identity
Christa Eloranta describes herself as a full-stack developer, designer and maker, a multidisciplinary generalist who connects ideas with practical, functional, user-centred outcomes. She sees software engineering and design as complementary forms of problem solving.

## Software development
According to the public About page, she has worked as a web developer since 2022 in a Tampere-based solutions company. Her described work includes accessible websites, warehouse integrations, modernizing a single sign-on system, and productizing company services. She emphasizes maintainable, understandable code and usability.

## Education and complementary expertise
- Bachelor of Engineering, Information and Communication Technology, Lapland University of Applied Sciences (2022–2025).
- Bachelor of Arts, interior and textile design, University of Lapland (2016–2019), including industrial design studies.
- Fine woodworking studies (2020–2022).
- Interior decoration studies (2015–2016).
- Bartending vocational specialization (2012–2013).

## Entrepreneurship and work experience
Her public timeline lists sole proprietorship from 2019, with commissioned physical products, interior renovation, window restoration, event-area lighting and online retail. Earlier restaurant-industry experience (2009–2019) contributed customer understanding, teamwork and adaptability.

## Approach and interests
Christa values curiosity, changing perspectives, learning, multidisciplinary collaboration, usability, technical quality, and developing solutions from concepts into real-world products. She is interested in collaborations combining technical and visual work, productization, concept design and prototyping.
